sheet.summary: Domestic silver prices have broken below the ₹2 lakh per kilogram mark to an 11-month low, erasing all calendar-year gains and dropping more than 53 percent from January's peak amid higher bond yields and cooling industrial demand. Salaried households face wider economic ripple effects as crude oil trading above $110 per barrel keeps local fuel prices elevated and feeds broad inflationary pressures. With the central bank responding by raising the benchmark repo rate, families must brace for higher borrowing costs that will directly increase home and auto loan EMIs.

topic.summary: A steep sell-off pushed silver below  ₹2 lakh per kg, wiping out its 2026 gains and leaving prices more than 50% below January’s record. Higher energy costs and rate-hike concerns are weighing on the metal, though analysts see potential support around  ₹1,80,000– ₹1,85,000.
